title: The Creeping Glasshouse
story: Inside the moonlit crystal glasshouse, three young gardeners are trapped behind a wall of silver vines that Verdrallow keeps growing from the floor tiles. The vine wall already covers part of the door, and it thickens fast. Mr 6 lifts his frost-lantern, whose cold light withers the creeper — but not as fast as it grows.
question: Verdrallow's vines spread over 4.5 square yards of the door every minute, while Mr 6's frost-lantern withers away 3 square yards every minute. The door is 18 square yards. How many minutes until the vines seal the door completely?
solution: Each minute the vines really gain 4.5 - 3 = 1.5 square yards.
Time to cover the whole door: 18 ÷ 1.5 = 12.
The door seals in 12 minutes — just enough time for Mr 6's rescue plan.
praise: Working with the vine's speed was exactly right — the missing step was subtracting the lantern's 3 square yards first, so you use the NET growth.
hint: The vines grow and the lantern shrinks them at the same time. Find how much the vine wall really gains in one minute before you divide.
victory: Mr 6 counted 12 minutes, used 11 of them to swing the gardeners out through the roof panel, and spent the last one waving goodbye. Verdrallow sealed a door with absolutely nobody behind it.
imagePrompt: A brave knight-numeral 6 in a blue cape raising a glowing frost-lantern against shimmering silver vines creeping across a moonlit crystal glasshouse door, with three frightened gardeners behind him.
